spans.s:
dhātu (ML), Buddhist; corporeal relics [of the Buddha].
 (IE

; EI 25), ‘seven’.
 Cf. Dhātu-parigṛhīta, an epithet of the Buddha; probably, salvation (Select Inscriptions, p. 228).
dhātu-garbha, ‘containing the corporeal relies of the Buddha’ (Journ. Mad. Univ., Vol. XXXII, p. 136).
dhātu-vara (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXVII, p. 16, text line 13), a Buddhist stūpa containing the Buddha's relics.
Dhātuvara-parigṛhīta (EI 20), ‘one who has attained nirvāṇa’; epithet of the Buddha. Cf. dhātu.
